w10_T4_006009: A village shop had 62 bunches of daffodils on Saturday. 51 bunches were bought before noon. A grower then delivered 36 more bunches to the shop. During the afternoon 42 bunches were sold to a wedding party. In the evening a second grower brought 72 bunches ready for Sunday. A dozen buckets stand outside the door. How many bunches of daffodils does the shop have now?
w10_T4_006014: Aiden's tile yard has 4 stacks, and each stack holds 161 tiles. A builder took 107 tiles for a bathroom. A cancelled job then returned 65 tiles to the yard. Later a school project used 207 tiles. Aiden keeps more tiles in his yard than his rival Beth does, and his van can carry 90 tiles at a time. How many tiles are in Aiden's yard?
w10_T4_006018: A radio station measures its adverts in seconds but sells them to clients in minutes. On Monday the station had 214 advert slots booked. A new client then added 55 slots. A cancellation removed 57 slots, and a second cancellation removed 30 more. A car dealer finally booked 25 slots. How many advert slots are booked now?
w10_T4_006021: A cannery counts its syrup in millilitres although the tins are printed in litres. On Monday morning 55 pallets were wheeled into the packing hall, and every pallet carries 7 crates. During the afternoon the crates were opened, and each crate holds 8 boxes. In the evening the boxes were unpacked, and each box holds 5 tins. A late delivery added 25 loose tins to the hall. How many tins are in the packing hall?
w10_T4_006022: Lars keeps 115 sheets of plywood in his workshop, and a supplier delivered 72 more. A kitchen job used 161 sheets, and a small repair used 9 more. A neighbour then returned 46 sheets that were the wrong size, and an auction added 24 sheets to the pile. Each sheet in the workshop can be cut into 7 shelves. Lars holds more plywood than his colleague Ida does, and his van is 5 metres long. How many shelves can Lars cut?
w10_T4_006025: A brewery measures its beer in millilitres but sells it in litres. On Monday morning 227 barrels were rolled into the yard, and each barrel fills 5 casks. During the afternoon every cask was tapped into 6 jugs. In the evening 5877 jugs went out to the pubs of the town. A pub returned 41 jugs the next morning, and 467 jugs were then sent to a festival. How many jugs does the brewery still have?
w10_T4_006027: A school had 94 recorders in its music room, and a grant paid for 62 more. 101 recorders were lent out to pupils for the term. Each recorder still in the room comes with 9 sheets of music in its case. The choir used 430 of those sheets for a concert, and a teacher then printed 27 more. A dozen music stands are kept in the corner, and the room is 12 metres wide. How many sheets of music are in the room?
w10_T4_006032: On Monday morning a bike shop had 93 inner tubes on the shelf. Before lunch 15 tubes were used on repairs. In the early afternoon a cycling club bought 56 tubes, and later that afternoon a customer took 11 more. In the evening the mechanic used 5 tubes on a delivery bike. A supplier then dropped off 13 tubes ready for the next day. The shop has 2 workshops. How many inner tubes are on the shelf?
w10_T4_006035: A cafe records its baking times in minutes and writes them on the rota in hours. The cafe had 40 jars of jam in its pantry, and a second batch made the number of jars 2 times as large. A market stall then gave the cafe 66 more jars, and a neighbour brought 14. All of the jars were shared equally among the cafe's 5 branches. How many jars went to one branch?
w10_T4_006036: On Monday morning a warehouse held 121 pallets in each of its 4 bays. During the afternoon the pallets were opened, and each pallet holds 6 sacks of flour. In the evening a lorry added 17 sacks, and the mill sent 60 more. Every sack fills 9 bread tins at the bakery next door. Marek counted more sacks this week than his colleague Ewa did, and the warehouse roof is 14 metres high. How many bread tins can be filled?
w10_T4_006050: A theatre workshop counts its rehearsal time in minutes and prints it on the call sheet in hours. The prop store held 130 wooden crates, and 128 of them were carried onto the stage for a play. Each crate left in the store was filled with 9 paper flowers. A dozen of those flowers were crushed and thrown away. A volunteer then made 55 more flowers for the store. How many paper flowers are in the store?
w10_T4_006051: Rosa keeps 19 boxes of beads in her studio, and each box holds 6 strings of beads. A friend gave her 15 more strings. Rosa then cut every string she had into 5 short lengths for a workshop. A supplier sent her 29 more short lengths, and a shop donated 69. Rosa has more lengths of beads than her colleague Tariq has. How many short lengths does Rosa have?
w10_T4_006052: A bakery records its proving times in minutes but writes them on the recipe cards in hours. Salim had 40 trays of dough in the fridge. He baked 17 trays in the morning and dropped 2 on the floor. A cafe ordered 16 trays, and a neighbour took 3 more. Each tray still in the fridge makes 9 buns. Salim has more trays left than his cousin Dalia has. How many buns can Salim still bake?
w10_T4_006059: A ferry company had 145 lifejacket lockers on its quay, and 85 lockers were moved to a new pier. Each locker still on the quay holds 8 boxes, and every box holds 9 lifejackets. A safety audit then added 64 lifejackets to the quay. The company shipped 3173 lifejackets out to its island route. The ferry crossing takes 40 minutes. How many lifejackets are on the quay?
w10_T4_006061: A wildlife park had 168 bags of feed in its store, and a delivery added 12 more, followed by 3 bags from a neighbour. Each bag was then tipped into 3 buckets for the keepers. A supplier sent 41 more buckets to the store. Every bucket holds 7 scoops of feed. The park keeps 60 species of animals. How many scoops of feed does the park have?
w10_T4_006068: A tile factory had 173 boxes ready for dispatch, and the night shift added 52 more. Each box holds 3 packs, every pack holds 8 sleeves, and every sleeve holds 7 tiles. Rahul packed more boxes this week than his colleague Meera did, and the factory is 30 years old. How many tiles has the factory prepared?
w10_T4_006074: A charity shop had 123 bags of clothes in the back room, and volunteers brought in 31 more and then 79 more. Each bag holds 5 items of clothing. The shop sold 74 items on Saturday, and a donation then added 32 items to the racks. Marta has sorted more bags than her colleague Jonas has, and a dozen new coat hangers were bought for the shop. How many items of clothing does the shop have?
w10_T4_006079: A seed company filled 209 sacks and split every sack into 6 tins for its shops. The tins were shared equally among the company's 6 shops, and Nell took the tins for the shop in the valley. Each tin in her shop holds 7 packets, every packet holds 8 envelopes, and every envelope holds 3 seeds. Nell's shop received more tins than Owen's smaller kiosk did last season, and a dozen shelves line her back wall. The company was founded 90 years ago. How many seeds are in Nell's shop?
w10_T4_006081: A pottery had 60 sacks of clay in its store, and a delivery made the number of sacks 2 times as large. The studio then used 39 sacks for a school order. The sacks that were left were shared equally among the pottery's 3 workrooms, and Ada took the room by the window. She was later given 35 more sacks from the store and 14 from a friend, which left her with more clay than her colleague Ben has in his room. Each sack in Ada's room makes 3 large bowls. How many bowls can Ada make?
w10_T4_006085: A juice bar measures its drinks in millilitres and prints litres on the menu board. The bar had 53 crates of oranges, and each crate holds 5 nets of fruit. A grower then gave the bar 41 more nets. Every net makes 6 glasses of juice, and a rival bar sent over 72 ready-made glasses. A dozen straws sit in a pot on the counter. How many glasses of juice does the bar have?
w10_T4_006093: A gym records its classes in minutes and puts them on the timetable in hours. The gym had 120 towels in its cupboard, and 27 of them went to the laundry. A delivery brought 31 clean towels, and the laundry returned 51 more. Members then took 113 towels during the day. The gym has 18 running machines. How many towels are in the cupboard now?
w10_T4_006094: Priya's plant nursery had 218 trays of seedlings, and 11 trays were spoiled by frost. A grower then delivered 66 more trays. Each tray holds 5 seedlings. A garden club later donated 72 loose seedlings to the nursery. Priya has more seedlings than her neighbour Anil has at his nursery. How many seedlings does Priya have?
w10_T4_006098: A library counts its loan periods in days but writes them on the receipts in weeks. On Monday morning the returns trolley held 76 books, and 36 were shelved before lunch. In the early afternoon 73 books were returned, and later that afternoon 73 more came back. In the evening a helper shelved 76 books from the trolley. Just before closing a school returned 51 books to the same trolley. How many books are on the trolley?
w10_T4_006102: A postal depot had 109 sacks of letters, and each sack holds 8 bundles. Every bundle holds 9 letters. On Tuesday 7298 letters were delivered to homes, and 21 letters were returned to sender and destroyed. A late collection added 41 letters to the depot, and a post box gave 29 more. How many letters are at the depot?
w10_T4_006105: A stationery shop had 202 packs of envelopes, and each pack holds 5 envelopes. A customer then returned 3 loose envelopes to the shop. During the sale 533 envelopes were bought, and 14 were spoiled by a leaking pen. A company ordered 233 envelopes and took them away. A dozen pens sit in a jar by the till. How many envelopes are left in the shop?
